config.description: EXP-001 confirmatory matrix per research/experiments/EXP-001/protocol.md (v1.0, frozen by the owner 2026-11-24). Items: ARC-Challenge test (regenerate with scripts/fetch_arc.py); the file and the 300-item subset are checked against the frozen SHA-256 and item IDs before any request.

quoted.controls: no other Ollama client active and no foreign model loaded (`ollama ps` checked before and after each arm)
quoted.exclusion: A run (arm x repetition block) is excluded and repeated once if: a foreign model was loaded, the machine was on battery, swap grew by more than 512 MiB, or the runtime version changed. Exclusions are logged with the reason and never silently dropped.
quoted.memory_abort: Abort on any sign of memory exhaustion (runner killed or swap growth above 2 GiB); report as a failure.
quoted.wall_cap: Wall-clock cap of 4 hours per experiment. If reached, the run stops, the completed blocks are kept and reported, and the experiment is marked incomplete.
